title: Finish shopping list document assembly and file output
description: Complete the orchestration service so it builds the ShoppingListDocument meals and aisle sections, performs duplicate-name protection, and writes the rendered markdown to the shopping-lists folder.
acceptance_criteria: Generated document title uses the user-selected list name.
`## Meals` bullets are emitted in plan order as `**<block heading>** — <recipe display name>` for recipe occurrences only.
Aggregated aisles are converted into shopping-list aisles, with unnamed aisles written as `Other` and items formatted via `ShoppingListLineFormatter`.
Target path resolves to `<folder>/shopping-lists/<sanitised>.md`, duplicate names raise `CreateError.listAlreadyExists`, and successful creation writes the markdown through existing file helpers.
